description: Erection of a single storey rear infill, rear and side extension following the demolition of the existing extension and replacement of the existing roof terrace balustrade and roof light.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (BNC/1/OD1 (Rev A); BNC/1/OD2 (Rev A); BNC/1/OD3 (Rev A)  Received:  18 January 2023
BNC/1/BLK; BNC/1/LOC; BNC/1/X1; BNC/1/X2; BNC/1/X3  Received:  16 December 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear infill, rear and side extension hereby approved.
